criteria.requirement: Ordinary input completes harvest, full cargo, sale and purchase with consistent feedback. Return/rescue results show actual kept/lost cargo and retained materials; failed saves do not report purchases, and current-visit recap clears on new departure/restart.

Both regions, single-serving flowers, unlock requirements and two-way shortcut are usable through ordinary input. Hub/pond/meadow stay distinct; courtyard return lands at its dance gate, sale/growth/departure remain individually reachable, creatures do not chase or damage, and per-trip refresh is checked. Route information is available at destination selection and in optional pause help; stocked jars match the original painted shop. Dance skip/reduced-motion/save transitions remain valid. Active progress/work animation, seeded moving flowers with saved regrowth, Q/right-click material collection and material upgrades, stamina return pressure, focal iris/dance transitions must be checked. SD15: stable harvest selection, held Q/right-mouse directional single target, empty pulse without action cost, partial-progress preservation and hold/charge/dash precedence. Both harvest and wing range growth and actual fewer-hit gains must be visible. SD16: pond lower-nectar / upper-material circuit and meadow shelter choice are traversable with ordinary input. Dense thickets block movement/dash and action line of sight; old valid v5 progress is preserved with safe recovery from newly occupied positions. Wildlife resting and travel phases remain readable and saveable.

Thirteen upgrade purchases, economy, reserve completion and invalid/duplicate transactions pass rules checks. Material conservation, regrowth, stamina growth and strict v1–v4 to v5 migration are included.
Pause/focus loss clears input; actual shutdown and cold resume preserve current and permanent state without legacy-save interference.

Native 960x600 and 1280x800 presentation is readable, coherent and spatially credible. Dance stage supports, art family, field guide and settings are checked at native scales. Home/flower/shortcut waymarks, off-screen return bearing, capacity appearance and sealed home reserve are checked at both scales. Selected flower work/nectar trail, directional gust, carried material loosening/drop/pickup and legible growth detail must agree with the rules. SD16: growth, destination, pause, shop, settings, completion, HUD resources and scene waymarks must share the painted garden family. No geometric hexagon waymark or oversized flat modal may stand in for the requested visual revision.
Complete ordinary-input native media and independent review, with no unresolved basic defect and honest actor/evidence boundaries.
Same frozen source/export, direct app and maintained command entry, input, save, exit, cold resume and old-save isolation are tested; old-save hashes correspond to retained before/after bytes.
Measured effort and unknowns, tracking readback, CI/integration state and candidate-only status are recorded accurately.
